_doc: Tier per path prefix, RELATIVE TO YOUR HOME FOLDER. First match wins. Unlisted paths default to tier A. Only tiers in config enabled_tiers are indexed (A by default). Tiers: A own projects/notes, A-docs (only *.md/*.txt), W work/client (keep off unless authorized), P personal/raw (chats, transcripts, career), R third-party repos, X never, D derived knowledge.
